title: Graph points split as iota x + kappa y with continuous linear iota, kappa
statement: For all natural numbers n, l there exist continuous linear maps iota : R^n -> R^(n+l) and kappa : R^l -> R^(n+l) such that graphPoint x y = iota x + kappa y for all x in R^n and y in R^l. Here R^k = EuclideanSpace R (Fin k) = Rn k, R^(n+l) = Amb n l, and graphPoint x y = toLp 2 (Fin.append (ofLp x) (ofLp y)) is the point of R^(n+l) whose first n coordinates are those of x and whose last l coordinates are those of y.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), ∃ (ι : Rn n →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (κ : Rn ℓ →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ), ∀ (x : Rn n) (y : Rn ℓ), graphPoint x y = ι x + κ y
